title: Finite complete coefficient stages for a nonzero nonunit
statement: Let l be prime and E/Q_l a finite extension, with its recorded ring of integers O [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let t in O be nonzero and not a unit. Every O/(t)^(n+1) is finite and annihilated by a power of l; all quotient transition maps for m <= n are surjective; O is complete for the ideal (t).

source.place: Construction 4.1, printed p. 21, the complete principal coefficient ring; nonuniformizer reduction by the discrete valuation decomposition (Serre, Local Fields, Chapter II, section 2).

proof.text: The DVR theorem supplies the actual maximal ideal J, a uniformizer pi and a finite residue field. Write t=v*pi^r, with v a unit; r=0 would make t a unit, so r>0. Thus (t)=J^r.
Mathlib finite_quotient_pow gives finiteness. The spectral norm of l is less than one, hence l belongs to J; therefore l^(r*(n+1)) belongs to (t)^(n+1). Quotient representatives prove surjectivity.

Apply the finite-module completeness theorem to O. Its maximal-adic topology is complete; Mathlib is_ideal_adic_pow identifies the topology for J^r with that for J, and isAdicComplete_iff transports completeness.

proof_origin.place: Construction 4.1; Lemma 5.13; Constructions 5.14–5.15 and Lemma 5.16. Explicit normalization through the recorded derived adjunctions.

lean.statement:
theorem nonunit_coefficient_stages
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E]
    (t : coefficientExtensionIntegers l E) (ht : t ≠ 0) (hunit : ¬ IsUnit t) :
    (∀ n : ℕ, Finite (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸
      (Ideal.span ({t} : Set (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) ^ (n + 1))) ∧
    (∀ n : ℕ, ∃ a : ℕ,
      (l ^ a : coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸
        (Ideal.span ({t} : Set (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) ^ (n + 1)) = 0) ∧
    (∀ {m n : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n), Function.Surjective
      (Ideal.Quotient.factor (Ideal.pow_le_pow_right (Nat.add_le_add_right h 1)) :
        (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸
          (Ideal.span ({t} : Set (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) ^ (n + 1)) →+*
        (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E ⧸
          (Ideal.span ({t} : Set (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E))) ^ (m + 1)))) ∧
    IsAdicComplete (Ideal.span ({t} : Set (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)))
      (coefficientExtensionIntegers l E)
